rationale: The file contains recognizable HLF transaction entrypoints (Init, Invoke, and helper methods create, query, delete, getHistory). However, no C1–C6 vulnerability patterns exist: (1) time.Now() is never called; (2) no goroutines are spawned; (3) no map iteration influences writes; (4) GetHistoryForKey result (L217) is only used to build a read-only response buffer, not to determine a write decision; (5) no package-level mutable state influences transaction logic. The getHistory method properly closes its iterator (L219 defer). All ledger writes (PutState, DelState) are driven by deterministic input validation and key construction, not nondeterministic sources.
